paragraphs: Axon Enterprise, Inc. ("Axon," the "Company," "we" or "us") is a technology company that provides integrated hardware and software solutions. Founder-led since 1993, Axon began with a mission to protect life and has grown into a global technology company serving a range of customers. Our products and services allow customers across the public and private sector to capture and use critical data to support fully-connected operational workflows. Our trusted network seamlessly integrates software and hardware with a range of connected devices, including TASER energy devices, cameras and sensors, drones and robotics, cloud-based evidence management, records management, real-time operations software, critical incident and emergency response systems, immersive training, and productivity tools – all enhanced by artificial intelligence ("AI"). Designed to work together, these solutions create a unified, data-driven operating system that prioritizes safety and helps protect people and places with greater speed, accuracy, transparency, and accountability.

Our integrated technology platform of hardware and software solutions advances our mission to (i) make the bullet obsolete, (ii) reduce social conflict, and (iii) enable a fair and effective justice system. Our products and technology solutions address complex, high-stakes challenges, and our mission attracts top talent. We aim to invent and deliver technology solutions that progressively make the right things easier and the wrong things harder every day.

Axon is a diversified technology company with employees distributed across multiple geographies. Alongside our primary corporate headquarters in Scottsdale, Arizona, we have hubs in many major cities across the United States and ongoing international expansion across Europe, Asia, and the Americas, as we continue to drive our mission globally.

During the year ended December 31, 2025, we realigned our business to better reflect our continued growth and expansion of our technology solutions. Previously reported within two reportable segments, TASER and Software and Sensors, we realigned our business in a manner that provides increased transparency and distinction between our software and services and hardware components.
Axon's operations comprise a fully integrated suite of products across connected hardware, software, and services which are disclosed in two reportable segments:

1.Software and Services: We develop, manufacture and sell cloud-based Software-as-a-Service ("SaaS") solutions that leverage AI and enable our customers to capture, securely store, manage, share and analyze video and other digital evidence. Our software offerings also support productivity and real-time operations. Our offerings include Axon Evidence, Draft One, Axon Records, Axon Standards, Axon Fusus, and Axon Assistant, among others. The Software and Services segment includes recurring cloud-hosted software revenue, related non-recurring professional services revenue, and revenue from certain software, including on-premise licenses.

2.Connected Devices: We develop, manufacture and sell fully integrated hardware solutions such as conducted energy devices ("CEDs") sold under the TASER brand, body cameras, fixed and in-car cameras, drone and counter-drone technologies, and a broad ecosystem of accessories, extended warranties and related hardware products.
For further information about our reportable segments and sales by geographic region, refer to Note 1 of Part II, Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

Axon's products and services are designed to operate as an integrated ecosystem consisting of integrated connected hardware devices, cloud-hosted software applications and real-time operational tools. Our revenue is derived from a combination of hardware sales, multi-year recurring software subscriptions, professional services, and extended warranties. The following describes the principal product categories that drive revenue across our two reportable segments.

Axon has a suite of cloud-based, SaaS solutions that deeply integrate with our hardware to benefit customers and drive annual recurring revenue, which totaled $1.3 billion1 as of December 31, 2025. Revenue from our SaaS solutions is primarily driven from subscription licensing, premium offering adoptions, and ecosystem expansion. Our SaaS solutions can be best categorized into three categories:

•Digital Evidence Management: Axon Evidence is a secure, cloud-based platform that enables public safety to efficiently store, manage and share critical evidence while ensuring chain of custody and compliance.

•Productivity Solutions: Our productivity suite includes Axon Records, Axon Standards, and a suite of solutions available under our AI Era Plan, including Real-Time Translation, Draft One, Policy Chat, and Auto-Transcribe, among others. These offerings are designed to boost efficiency and improve decision-making through automation, data integration, and intelligent workflows.

•Real-time Operations: Our real-time operations capabilities, which include Axon Respond, integrates location data, signal alerts and video feeds to provide a complete picture of evolving situations as they occur.

In addition to subscription SaaS revenue, this segment includes non-recurring professional services revenue supporting implementation, configuration, and ongoing workflow integration, as well as revenue from certain on-premise software licenses.

paragraphs: Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations ("MD&A") provides the perspective of our management on our financial condition, results of operations, liquidity and certain other factors that may affect our future results. MD&A should be read in conjunction with the other sections of this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The discussion includes references to non-GAAP financial measures, such as adjusted gross margin, which supplement our GAAP results by providing additional insight into our financial and operational performance. For definitions and reconciliations of these non-GAAP measures to the most directly comparable GAAP measures, refer to "Non-GAAP Measures" within this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The various sections of our MD&A contain forward-looking statements, all of which are based on our current expectations and could be affected by the uncertainties and risk factors described throughout this filing.

MD&A discusses our results of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025 as compared to the year ended December 31, 2024. For discussion of the year ended December 31, 2024 as compared to the year ended December 31, 2023, refer to MD&A included in Part II, Item 7 of our amended 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K/A for the year ended December 31, 2024, filed with the SEC on May 7, 2025.

Axon is a technology company that provides integrated hardware and software solutions. Our products and services allow customers across the public and private sector to capture and use critical data to support fully-connected operational workflows. Our trusted network seamlessly integrates software and hardware with a range of connected devices, including TASER energy devices, cameras and sensors, drones and robotics, cloud-based evidence management, records management, real-time operations software, critical incident and emergency response systems, immersive training, and productivity tools – all enhanced by AI.

During the year ended December 31, 2025, we realigned our business into two reportable segments, Connected Devices and Software and Services (the "Segment Realignment"). As a result of the Segment Realignment, we have recast our segment and other relevant disclosures for the year ended December 31, 2024 to conform to the new presentation.

Our revenues for the year ended December 31, 2025 were $2.8 billion, an increase of $697.0 million, or 33.5%, from the year ended December 31, 2024. We had loss from operations of $62.1 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, compared to income from operations of $58.5 million for the same period in the prior year. Gross margin dollars increased $416.7 million and increased as a percentage of revenue to 59.7% from 59.6% compared to the year ended December 31, 2024. Adjusted gross margin decreased to 62.6% for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to 63.2% for the year ended December 31, 2024. The decrease was primarily driven by global tariffs and a higher mix of Platform Solutions revenue. Operating expenses increased by $537.4 million, reflecting increased headcount to support business growth and stock-based compensation expense. Net income of $124.7 million included net realized and unrealized gains of $186.4 million related to our strategic investments and a $105.7 million tax benefit, partially offset by a net realized and unrealized loss of $46.4 million related to our marketable securities, inducement expense of $38.9 million associated with the early repurchase of a portion of our 2027 Notes, and interest loss, net of $18.8 million. Net income of $377.0 million for the year ended December 31, 2024 included net realized and unrealized gains of $162.9 million related to our strategic investments, a net unrealized gain of $120.3 million related to our marketable securities, and interest income, net of $36.6 million.

headings: 關鍵產品類別營收驅動因素：我們提供的產品與服務
銷售與行銷：我們銷售給誰以及我們的配送地點
paragraphs: Axon Enterprise, Inc. ("Axon," the "Company," "we" or "us") 為一間科技公司，提供整合的硬體與軟體解決方案。自1993年起由創辦人領導，Axon 以保護生命為使命，已成長為一家全球科技公司，服務多種客戶。我們的產品與服務讓公部門與私部門的客戶能夠捕捉並使用關鍵資料，以支援完整的作業流程。我們的可信網路無縫整合軟體與硬體，與多種連線裝置，包括 TASER 能量裝置、相機與感測器、無人機與機械人、雲端基準證據管理、記錄管理、即時作業軟體、關鍵事件與緊急應變系統、沉浸式訓練，以及生產力工具 – 全部皆透過人工智慧 ("AI") 進行增強。這些解決方案設計為協同運作，創造出一個統一的資料驅動作業系統，優先考量安全，並以更高的速度、準確性、透明度與責任感保護人與場所。
我們的整合科技平台透過硬體與軟體解決方案，推進我們的使命，即 (i) 讓子彈過時，(ii) 減少社會衝突，以及 (iii) 建立一個公平且有效的司法系統。我們的產品與科技解決方案解決複雜且高風險的挑戰，而我們的使命吸引頂尖人才。我們的目標是發明並交付科技解決方案，使正確的事變得更容易，錯誤的事變得更困難。
Axon 為一間多元化科技公司，員工分佈於多個地理區域。除了位於亞利桑那州 Scottsdale 的主要公司總部外，我們在美國許多主要城市設有中心，並持續在歐洲、亞洲與美洲進行國際擴張，以推動我們的使命。
在截至2025年12月31日的會計年度中，我們重新調整業務，以更符合我們持續成長與擴張科技解決方案的現狀。先前歸類於兩個應報告分部，即 TASER 與軟體與感測器，我們重新調整業務，以提供軟體與服務與硬體零組件之間更高的透明度與區分。
Axon 的營運包含一整套整合的產品，涵蓋連線硬體、軟體與服務，並歸類於兩個應報告分部：

1.軟體與服務：我們開發、製造與銷售基於雲端的軟體即服務 ("SaaS") 解決方案，運用人工智慧 ("AI")，使客戶能夠捕捉、安全儲存、管理、分享與分析影片及其他數位證據。我們的軟體產品也支援生產力與即時作業。我們的產品包括 Axon Evidence、Draft One、Ax, Axon Standards、Axon Fusus、Axon Assistant 等。軟體與服務分部包含重複性雲端主機軟體收入、相關非重複性專業服務收入，以及來自部分軟體的收入，包括本地安裝授權。
2.連線裝置：我們開發、製造與銷售完全整合的硬體解決方案，例如以 TASER 品牌銷售的導能裝置 ("CEDs")、身體相機、固定與車載相機、無人機與反無人機技術，以及廣泛的配件、延長保固與相關硬體產品。
如需進一步資訊關於我們的應報告分部與各地理區域的銷售情況，請參閱本年度報告 10-K 表單 Part II, Item 8 中的附註 1。
Axon 的產品與服務設計為一個整合生態系統，包含整合連線的硬體裝置、雲端主機的軟體應用程式以及即時運作工具。我們的營業收入來自於硬體銷售、多年期軟體訂閱、專業服務以及延長保固的組合。以下說明驅動我們兩個應報告分部收入的主要產品類別。
Axon 有整套基於雲端的 SaaS 解決方案，與我們的硬體深度整合，以造福客戶並推動年度經常性收入，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，總計為 1.3 十億美元。我們的 SaaS 解決方案收入主要來自訂閱授權、高階方案採用以及生態系擴張。我們的 SaaS 解決方案可歸納為三個類別：
•數位證據管理：Axon Evidence 是一個安全的雲端平台，使公眾安全能夠高效地儲存、管理與分享關鍵證據，同時確保證據鏈及合規性。
•生產力解決方案：我們的生產力套件包含 Axon Records、Axon Standards，以及在 AI 世代計畫下提供的解決方案，包括即時翻譯、Draft One、政策聊天以及自動轉錄等，其他還有更多。這些產品設計用以提升效率並改善決策，透過自動化、資料整合與智慧化工作流程。
•即時運作：我們的即時運作能力，包含 Axon Respond，整合了位置資料、訊號警報與視訊訊號，以提供對正在發生的事件的完整圖像。
除了訂閱 SaaS 收入外，此分部還包括非重複性專業服務收入，用以支援實作、設定以及持續的工作流程整合，以及來自某些內部軟體授權的收入。

paragraphs: 管理階層對財務狀況與營運結果的討論與分析（"MD&A"）提供本公司管理階層對本公司財務狀況、營運結果、流動性及可能影響未來結果的其他因素的觀點。MD&A 應與本年度 10-K 申報書的其他部分一併閱讀。討論中包含非 GAAP 財務指標的參考，例如調整後的毛利率，這些指標透過提供額外的財務與營運表現洞察，補充我們的 GAAP 結果。有關這些非 GAAP 指標的定義與其與最直接可比較的 GAAP 指標的調整說明，請參閱本年度 10-K 申報書中的 "Non-GAAP Measures" 部分。我們 MD&A 各個部分包含前瞻性陳述，所有這些陳述均基於本公司目前的預期，並可能受到本申報書中所描述的不確定性及風險因素的影響。
MD&A 討論本公司 2025 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的營運結果，與 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的營運結果比較。有關 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日與 2023 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的比較，請參閱本公司修正後的 2024 年度 10-K 申報書（Part II, Item 7）中所包含的 MD&A，該申報書於 2025 年 5 月 7 日提交至 SEC。
Axon 是一家科技公司，提供整合的硬體與軟體解決方案。我們的產品與服務允許公部門與私部門的客戶捕捉並使用關鍵資料，以支持完整的連線作業流程。我們的可信網路無縫整合軟體與硬體，與一系列連線裝置搭配使用，包括 TASER 能量裝置、相機與感測器、無人機與機械人、雲端證據管理、記錄管理、即時作業軟體、關鍵事件與緊急應變系統、沉浸式訓練，以及生產力工具 – 所有這些皆透過 AI 進行增強。
在 2025 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的年度中，我們將業務重新劃分為兩個應報告分部，即 Connected Devices 與 Software and Services（"Segment Realignment"）。由於 Segment Realignment 的實施，我們已重新整理 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的分部及其他相關揭露，以符合新的呈現方式。

我們在 2025 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的營業收入為 28 億美元，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的營業收入增加 6.97 億美元，或成長 33.5%。我們在 2025 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的營運虧損為 6,210 萬美元，與 2024 年同期的營運獲利 5,850 萬美元相比。毛利率金額增加 4.167 億美元，毛利率佔營業收入的百分比提高至 59.7%，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的 59.6%。調整後的毛利率在 2025 年 12 月 31 日為結算日降至 62.6%，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的 63.2% 下降。此下降主要由全球關稅及較高的 Platform Solutions 收入比例所驅動。營運費用增加 5.374 億美元，反映因業務成長而增加的人力資源及股票基於報酬費用。淨利潤 1.247 億美元包含與戰略投資相關的淨實現與未實現獲利 1.864 億美元，以及稅務利益 1.057 億美元，部分抵銷與市場可交易證券相關的淨實現與未實現虧損 4,640 萬美元、與早期回購部分 2027 年債券相關的誘因費用 3,890 萬美元，以及淨利息損失 1,880 萬美元。2024 年 12 月 31 日為結算日的淨利潤為 3.77 億美元，包含與戰略投資相關的淨實現與未實現獲利 1.629 億美元，與市場可交易證券相關的淨未實現獲利 1.203 億美元，以及淨利息收入 3,660 萬美元。

headings: 與我們負債相關的風險
本公司極度依賴全球法執法機關持續接受我們的產品與服務，若需求減少，將可能對我們的業務造成重大不利影響。
本公司極度依賴CEDs產品的銷售，若這些產品無法持續被廣泛接受，將會使我們的成長潛力、營運成果與財務狀況受到影響。
若我們無法成功設計、推出、銷售及部署新產品或新產品功能，將可能對本公司業務與財務結果造成不利影響。
我們面臨因技術快速變遷及新競爭產品而產生的風險。
負面宣傳可能對銷售造成不利影響，進而導致本公司營業收入或營運結果下降。
收購或投資其他產品、技術或企業，可能幹擾本公司業務、稀釋股東價值，或對本公司營運結果造成不利影響。
本公司可能無法成功管理成長或規劃未來成長。
材料供應不足或成本上升，可能對本公司財務結果造成不利影響。
國內與全球經濟環境的重大不利發展，或發生其他足夠具幹擾性的世界事件，可能對本公司營業收入與營運結果造成重大不利影響。
產品開發進度延誤，可能對本公司營業收入與現金流造成不利影響。
我們因銷售週期長而投入大量資源預備銷售，但可能最終無法獲得任何營業收入。
重大災難事件可能對我們的業務前景、營運成果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
在我們的產品與服務中，AI的發展、部署與應用存在不確定性，且對我們的業務整體亦有影響，可能對我們的業務與聲譽造成不利影響。
我們服務中的缺陷或中斷可能影響服務需求，並使我們面臨重大賠償責任。
我們產品中的缺陷可能降低產品需求，或導致產品回收，進而造成銷售減少、市場接受度延遲及聲譽受損。
我們的國際業務使我們面臨額外風險，可能損害我們的業務前景、營運成果及財務狀況。
我們依賴我們吸引並留住關鍵管理、銷售及技術人員的能力。
